description: One company in Spain, any the site lists, down to one salary: overall, and by role, region or experience wherever it has salaries. Each figure says how many people it comes from, and few: true marks fewer than 5. Give a role, region or years to see the groups within it, combinations included. A name the site does not list gets close names to try. Companies listed apart under a name that starts like it (BBVA and BBVA Technology) come back in related_companies.

context.description: Why are you calling this tool? Describe the goal in general terms, and refer to people by role ("a candidate") rather than by name. Leave out personal and identifying information.

region.description: Spanish region code or name, e.g. MD, Madrid, CT, Cataluña. Omit, or pass spain or remote, for all of Spain.

role.description: Role slug or name, e.g. software-engineer, Data Scientist, product-manager. Omit for all roles.

years.description: Years of experience, as a number such as 6 or a bucket such as 5-7. Omit for any experience.

name: company_salaries
title: One company's salaries
